cells.scene: A skeptical listener changes to an understanding nod as another person points to matching paw prints and a photograph; evidence persuades the listener.
An adult lies awake in bed as a loud alarm clock rings nearby, eyebrows worried and hands over ears.
A volunteer holds a collection box while several people each add one coin, pooled funds for a community project.
A handheld electric torch casts a narrow pale blue cone of light onto a small stone in a dark patch.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — convince (v.使…信服): A skeptical listener changes to an understanding nod as another person points to matching paw prints and a photograph; evidence persuades the listener.
TOP RIGHT — disturb (v.令人不安): An adult lies awake in bed as a loud alarm clock rings nearby, eyebrows worried and hands over ears.
BOTTOM LEFT — raise (v.募集，筹(款)): A volunteer holds a collection box while several people each add one coin, pooled funds for a community project.
BOTTOM RIGHT — torchlight (n.电筒光): A handheld electric torch casts a narrow pale blue cone of light onto a small stone in a dark patch.
review_notes: Reviewed all four cells: evidence persuades listener; alarm disturbs rest; donors collect funds; torch beam illuminates stone. Subjects and hands remain within quadrants; no baked labels.
